text:
marco: kicking off a 5% canary for v3-int4 on docs-longcontext. latency/throughput nominal but early quality shows weird drop in entity overlap metric. infra-bot: canary started model=v3-int4 slice=5% run=canary-4987654321
tanya: how big is the sample? is this consistent across windows?
marco: ~3.1k requests in first 20m. entity_overlap(control)=0.812, entity_overlap(canary)=0.786 => delta=-0.026 (-3.2%). that seems larger than expected.
oliver: entity_overlap is our fraction of gold entities present in model output after normalization, right? could tokenization differences or detokenized punctuation be skewing it?
tanya: yes normalized matching. also it's sensitive to small formatting diffs. suggest pairing it with a relaxed fuzzy-match (overlap_fuzzy) and requiring both to move before autofallback.
marco: propose hybrid gate: autofallback if either (1) relative MRR drop >= 4% OR (2) entity_overlap drop >= 2.5% AND fuzzy_overlap drop >= 1.5% across two consecutive 10m windows with min_n=1500 per window.
sre-ops: operational note: prefer consecutive-window hysteresis = 2 and action = pause+notify instead of immediate full rollback for non-critical regressions.
infra-bot: telemetry window1(0-10m): mrr_delta=-1.2%, entity_overlap_delta=-2.6%, fuzzy_overlap_delta=-1.4%, n=1600; window2(10-20m): mrr_delta=-1.4%, entity_overlap_delta=-2.7%, fuzzy_overlap_delta=-1.6%, n=1505
infra-bot: gate evaluation: entity_overlap meets threshold but fuzzy_overlap only crosses in window2. hybrid rule not fully satisfied yet.
marco: hmm. that's on the border. i'm going to hold promotion and enable extra logging for mismatch cases to s3://redwood-debug/entities-4987654321/ for 3h. please also capture tokenization diffs and normalization id maps.
oliver: i'll run a 1h shadow with v3-int4 on a 10% sampled cohort and a targeted tokenizer normalization ablation to see sensitivity.
tanya: also let's run a small unit of synthetic entity insertions to check recall vs hallucination tradeoff. if recall drops but hallucination remains steady we might be trimming outputs too aggressively in generation.
marco: agreed. action items: marco enable debug dump + pause promote; oliver schedule shadow + tokenizer ablation; tanya run synthetic recall test. we'll reconvene after 1h of extra telemetry. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
